note: Mr. Thorne now bought Mia's cake at seven, not nine, and no clue places her at the tent at the crash, so nothing rules Mia out.

patch.value: At nine o'clock I bought carrot cake from young Mia at the fair's cake tent, across town. She was serving there from six till ten.
At seven o'clock I bought carrot cake from young Mia at the fair's cake tent, across town.
Mr. Thorne was at the growers' barbecue, right by our cake tent, all evening. At nine o'clock he bought carrot cake from me.
Mr. Thorne was at the growers' barbecue, right by our cake tent, all evening. At seven o'clock he bought carrot cake from me.
Friday 7pm to 11pm: at the growers' barbecue next to the cake tent. At 9pm he bought carrot cake from Mia.
Friday 7pm to 11pm: at the growers' barbecue next to the cake tent. At 7pm he bought carrot cake from Mia.
Friday 6pm to 10pm: helped her mum serve at the fair's cake tent across town. Mr. Thorne was at the growers' barbecue next door all evening, and at 9pm she sold him carrot cake.
Friday 6pm to 10pm: helped her mum serve at the fair's cake tent across town. Mr. Thorne was at the growers' barbecue next door all evening, and at 7pm she sold him carrot cake.
Mr. Thorne bought cake from Mia at the fair across town at nine.
Mr. Thorne bought cake from Mia at the fair across town at seven.

Grumpy and offended, he insists he only ever looked over the fence. He is proud of his evening at the fair and shares it freely, including buying cake from Mia at nine. He hides that he climbed over on Friday afternoon, because he is embarrassed to have spied on a children's pumpkin.

Friday: at 4pm Mr. Thorne climbs over the fence to measure Bertha through the side window, leaving huge boot prints. At 5pm Mia waters Bertha, sees the prints, locks up and returns the spare at 5:20. Mr. Thorne takes Goliath to the fair at 6:30pm and is at the growers' barbecue from 7 to 11; Mia serves at the cake tent from 6 to 10 and sells him carrot cake at 9. At 8pm Mr. Dobbs sees Bertha whole and the door locked.
